description.value: Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza is a six-storey full-service hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, shops, and dining. The property offers a range of room types from traditional rooms to family suites with full kitchens, catering to both short stays and extended visits. Valet parking with EV charging is available on-site, and guests note the walkable location and attentive front-desk staff.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: shed (covered, secure) at 84m; rack (6 spaces) at 85m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is operational in downtown Victoria under the 'Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza' name, matching the OSM name field. The website prominently features EV charging via valet parking but makes no mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or most other cyclist-specific amenities; the only confirmable amenity from website content is the valet/EV charging service. A name discrepancy exists between the OSM name ('Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza') and the OSM official_name tag ('Aiden by Best Western'), and the website-displayed toll-free phone (1-800-663-7241) differs from the OSM local number (+1-250-388-5513).
concerns: OSM name ('Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza') conflicts with OSM official_name tag ('Aiden by Best Western') — possible rebrand in progress or incomplete OSM edit.
Phone number mismatch: OSM records +1-250-388-5513 (local) but the website prominently displays 1-800-663-7241 (toll-free); may be two valid numbers but warrants verification.
Website content appears truncated mid-sentence in the FAQ section; full amenity list not captured — cyclist-specific amenities may exist but could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational downtown Victoria hotel confirmed open via website; useful to touring cyclists as a centrally located accommodation option.
enrichment_extras.notes: EV charging is available on-site via valet parking (per website), but it is framed as a car service; suitability for e-bike charging is unconfirmed and would need direct inquiry.
